visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable frames including the compact preview. The cubic western hall retains its three dark upper bands and projecting triple-pointed-arch screen. The east forecourt is open and paved, with low pointed galleries, a tall east through gate and a single octagonal minaret on a tiered square base. The tower has upper slit fields, flared crown, dark opaque lantern panels and a small pale cap/finial. Added base recesses before final captures. All heights, detailed internal partitions and minor parapet rhythms are estimates. Fine calligraphy, lattice art, furniture, lighting fixtures and unseen interiors are omitted.

Metric UVs, linear tints and low-frequency texture scale; zero embedded images, copied night lighting or unique facade atlases. Every graph is read once; eviction leaves zero live model geometries.
